insights.text: Taiwan is still 34% below its 2019 level, the biggest shortfall in this Top 50.
Albania (#32) nearly doubled since 2019 (+87%), the fastest growth on this list.
China isn't ranked: it hasn't published 2024 overnight arrivals. In 2019: 65.7M.
Saudi Arabia (#13) has 70% more visitors than in 2019, the fastest rise in the top 15.
Türkiye (+18%) has overtaken Italy (-11%) since 2019 to take No. 4.

scope_note: What counts: international tourist arrivals in 2024 (overnight visitors, millions) as compiled by UN Tourism; where its database has no 2024 value, the national figure from the same series is used. Some countries count at the border, others at hotels, and a few include same-day visits or citizens living abroad (noted on the card). Hong Kong and Macao are listed separately, as UN Tourism does. Not ranked for lack of a 2024 figure: China, UAE, Denmark, Bulgaria, Russia. Change vs 2019 uses the same series.
